programs.title: Weird Wonders
programs.desc: A case of a mystery stinger occurs in Australia; a scientist is poisoned during a jungle expedition; goats are flying in Utah.

programs.title: Weird Wonders
programs.desc: Hundreds of reindeer are mysteriously dying in Norway; a boiling river in Peru; red rain appears in Spain.

programs.title: Volcano
programs.desc: When a massive earthquake rocks the city of Los Angeles, Emergency Management department head Mike Roark (Tommy Lee Jones) returns from his vacation to help with the city's response. After geologist Dr. Amy Barnes (Anne Heche) warns that a volcano may be forming in sewer tunnels, another severe earthquake unleashes the lava flowing underfoot, threatening to destroy the whole city. As the fiery molten rock runs through the streets, Roark and Barnes must figure out how to divert it.

programs.title: Starship Troopers
programs.desc: In the distant future, the Earth is at war with a race of giant alien insects. Little is known about the Bugs except that they are intent on the eradication of all human life. But there was a time before the war... A Mobile Infantry travels to distant alien planets to take the war to the Bugs. They are a ruthless enemy with only one mission: Survival of their species no matter what the cost...

programs.title: Men at Work
programs.desc: Carl Taylor (Charlie Sheen) and James St. James (Emilio Estevez) are garbage men who spend their workdays goofing around and disrupting the quiet on the streets of their town. But their good-natured fun comes to an abrupt halt when they discover a local politician's corpse in one of their cans. Determined that this is their chance to be more than trash collectors, this snarky pair of amateur detectives decide to solve the case on their own and so become entangled in a toxic waste cover-up.

programs.title: The Dukes of Hazzard
programs.desc: Bo and Luke Duke are a pair of good-ol'-boy brothers who tear through rural Hazzard County, Ga., transporting moonshine for their kindhearted Uncle Jesse in their tricked-out car, the General Lee. When they learn that corrupt political kingpin Boss Hogg is evicting farmers so he can sell their land to an evil coal mining operation, the boys and their comely cousin Daisy decide to fight back.

programs.title: A Knight's Tale
programs.desc: Peasant-born William Thatcher (Heath Ledger) begins a quest to change his stars, win the heart of an exceedingly fair maiden (Shanynn Sossamon) and rock his medieval world. With the help of friends (Mark Addy, Paul Bettany, Alan Tudyk), he faces the ultimate test of medieval gallantry -- tournament jousting -- and tries to discover if he has the mettle to become a legend.

programs.title: The Vampire Lestat
programs.desc: Lestat reflects on the events leading to his tour, including the formation of his band and the publication of a certain book, while experiencing a disquieting, drug-fueled spiritual trip and going head-to-head with a resentful coven.

programs.title: Criminal Minds
programs.desc: The BAU looks to outsiders for clues when three college athletes disappear the night of a pep rally; J.J. is instrumental in moving the case forward.

programs.title: Criminal Minds

programs.title: Criminal Minds
programs.desc: The daughter of high-powered diplomats must battle suspicions of nepotism when her assignment to the unit takes place without notification to Hotch or Gideon.

programs.title: Criminal Minds
programs.desc: The BAU goes to Guantánamo Bay to interrogate the leader of a terrorist sleeper-cell to prevent a national disaster.
